title: Add portfolio performance summary endpoint
description:
As a portfolio manager, I want a REST endpoint that calculates the current performance metrics of a portfolio — total return, annualised return, benchmark delta — and returns them as a JSON response.

The endpoint must:
- Accept a portfolio ID and an optional date range.
- Return a summary object: total_return (%), annualised_return (%), benchmark_delta (%).
- Handle portfolios with no history gracefully (return zeroed metrics, not 404).
- Respond within 300ms for a standard portfolio.

Out of scope: streaming or websocket updates.

title: Add portfolio allocation breakdown endpoint
description:
As a portfolio manager, I want a REST endpoint that returns the current asset allocation breakdown for a given portfolio, including percentage per asset class.

The endpoint must:
- Accept a portfolio ID.
- Return a list of asset class allocations: {asset_class, symbol, quantity, weight_pct}.
- Return HTTP 404 for unknown portfolio IDs.
- Respond within 400ms for portfolios up to 150 positions.

Out of scope: rebalancing logic.

title: Migrate market data service config to environment variables
description:
The market data service has hardcoded API keys and endpoint URLs in the source code. These must be moved to environment variables before the next release.

Affected files: services/market_data.py, config/settings.py.

This is a refactor — no functional changes to API behaviour expected. A .env.example file must document all required variables.

title: Move database connection strings out of source code
description:
Database connection strings are currently hardcoded in db/connection.py. These must be replaced with environment variable lookups.

All connection strings must be read from environment variables at startup. A .env.example must document each variable. Application must fail fast with a clear error if required variables are absent.

title: Add light/dark theme toggle to settings panel
description:
Users have requested a visual theme toggle in the settings panel. Implement a switch that toggles between light and dark themes. The preference must persist across page reloads.

The toggle should be accessible — keyboard navigable and screen-reader labelled. Both themes must meet WCAG AA contrast ratios.

Open unknowns: Should preference sync across devices? Where is preference stored — localStorage or user profile?

title: Add portfolio positions list endpoint
description:
As a portfolio manager, I want a REST endpoint to retrieve all current positions in a portfolio, including current market value and unrealised PnL.

The endpoint must:
- Accept a portfolio ID.
- Return a list of positions: {asset_symbol, quantity, average_cost, current_price, market_value, unrealised_pnl}.
- Return HTTP 404 for unknown portfolio IDs.
- Handle empty portfolios (return empty list, not error).
